hero.headline: Security & Privacy by Design
hero.lead: Scytáles builds digital identity with the highest levels of data protection and user control from day one, not as an afterthought. Citizens decide what to share, when, and with whom.

sections.heading: What security and privacy by design means
paragraphs: High-assurance mobile identity depends on cryptography, secure credential management, and architectures that keep personal data on the holder's device whenever possible.
Scytáles solutions are shaped by eIDAS 2.0, GDPR, and NIS2, ensuring compliance readiness while delivering selective disclosure, consent-based sharing, and interoperable trust.
From wallets and validators to age verification and authenticated readers, every product is engineered so privacy is the default and security is measurable at High Level of Assurance.

points.title: User consent first
points.body: Share only the attributes a service truly needs.

points.title: Device-held data
points.body: Credentials stay with the holder, not in a central silo.

points.title: Regulatory mastery
points.body: Aligned with eIDAS 2.0, GDPR, and NIS2.

points.title: High Level of Assurance
points.body: Cryptography and controls built for critical use cases.

sections.heading: Why Scytáles
sections.lead: Deep expertise in digital identity, cryptography, and regulatory compliance, trusted by the European Commission to build the infrastructure that will serve over 450 million EU citizens.
